paper_metadata.title: Effects of Ru and Re additions on the high temperature flow stresses of Ni-base single crystal superalloys

evidence.quote: Effects of Ru and Re additions on the high temperature flow stresses of Ni-base single crystal superalloys

other.description: doping a solute-lean base alloy with Re or Ru

evidence.quote: chemistries of the experimental alloys ( Table 1 ), were obtained by doping a vacuum induction melted (VIM) solute-lean base alloy with varying levels of Re or Ru

other.description: modified laboratory-scale Bridgman furnace; single crystal rods 12.7 mm diameter x 100 mm length

evidence.quote: All ﬁve alloys were solidiﬁed as single crystal rods measuring 12.7 mm in diameter and 100 mm in length using a modiﬁed laboratory-scale Bridgman furnace.

other.description: long ramped cycle rising in steps to 1364 C

evidence.quote: The as-cast samples were solution heat-treated in a vacuum furnace using a long, ramped cycle rising in steps to 1364 C, at which temperature the material was held for 20 h to ensure homogenization.
The solution heat treatment was then followed by a primary age for 5 h at 1140 C and secondary age of 16 h at 870 C.
The solution heat treatment was then followed by a primary age for 5 h at 1140 C and secondary age of 16 h at 870 C.

other.description: single phase gamma crystals cast into single crystals

evidence.quote: The single phase c and c0 alloys were also cast into single crystals using the same modiﬁed Bridgman furnace.
As-solidiﬁed crystals of the c phase were homogenized at 1360 C for 48 h, while the c0 crystals were homogenized for 48 h at 1280 C.
